label: HiSense LTF7267-BHA+ XGS-PON SFP+ ONU
description: XGS-PON ONU built into an SFP+ module (Cortina CA8271S, Saturn SDK Linux, SC/APC BOSA) that presents a 10GBASE-R host interface to the router's SFP+ cage; XGS-PON line rate 9.953 Gbit/s symmetric with no LAN ports and no Wi-Fi, managed over its web UI, SSH, telnet or TTL serial console.
